attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole account of her is one sentence and one couplet. She is not the corpus's `theotimus-of-tomis` or `theotimus-the-executioner`, who are men of a masculine form of the name and are kept on other days. No year, no place, no companions, no hymn.
